name: GazeNeRF
definition: A 3D-aware gaze redirection method that reformulates the task as a neural volume rendering problem. It uses a two-stream MLP architecture to separately predict volumetric features for the face and eye regions, allowing for rigid 3D rotation of the eye features to achieve gaze redirection while preserving identity.
summary: GazeNeRF is a 3D-aware gaze redirection method that uses a two-stream neural volume rendering architecture to independently model face and eye features, ensuring 3D consistency by applying rigid rotation to the eyes.
